invariants: Every selected domain is justified by a named management question and a decision it informs.
Registry membership, tags and convenience never require domain inclusion.
Every domain fact remains mastered and corrected in its owning domain.
The landscape has no write path into source masters and stores no competing domain-data copy.
Every cross-domain transition preserves master, steward, asserting party, evidence, time, rights and uncertainty.
Shared labels never establish identity, equivalence or comparability.
Every semantic-conflict axis is classified comparable, bridged by a named transformation or non-comparable.
Missing comparability verdict means non-comparable and recency never resolves a dispute.
Completeness is relative to named questions, selected domains, perimeter, denominator, granularity and opaque segments.
Unavailable, withheld, suppressed, unknown, pending, not-selected and zero remain distinct.
Membership in a landscape grants no access and the most restrictive constituent rule governs derived disclosure.
World time and knowledge time are pinned separately.
Projection outputs are immutable, digest-identified and non-reimportable.
Corrections append successors and scenarios never become authoritative facts.
No managed-IT graph or other domain model becomes a universal enterprise kernel.
